# Section 1: Overview

# Purpose
Purpose of this document is to describe understanding of OCR functionality practiced in Shahi Exports.

# Business Requirement
In Shahi, once all of the sales orders are shipped then Style moves to OCR category. These styles start listing in OCR workplace where different department teams perform different action and update.
Once a style is flagged as closed by all the relevant department, subject style is submitted for BI Team review. Upon receipt of style BI team analyse transaction status related to respective style and confirm on OCR closure.
Styles post OCR closure are taken in periodic MIS for various management meetings. In essence, OCR is the formal closure of a styles and respective sales orders.
During this OCR multiple activities are performed in control environment which are explained in detail in this document.

## Workflow

# Section 2. Assumptions

# Assumptions
• No Assumptions

# Section 3. Solution

# Functional Requirement.

## OCR Rules
There will be a configuration windows where admin can define OCR rules based on Buyer and Product Categories as shown below:

Q . Why we are not handling this through buyer shipment tolerance.
If shipment tolerance is enabled, the configured OCR threshold shall include the shipment tolerance defined in the Buyer Master during shipment validation.
• Buyer Master Shipment Tolerance = 10%
• OCR Rule Threshold = 90%
• Tolerance Enabled = Yes
• System calculates 10% of the Order Qty
Navigation: - Admin Configurator Configuration Rules OCR Rules
• Quick Searching Parameter – Buyer and Category
• Filter Parameter – Buyer and Category
• Context Menu – In Context menu we need to provide Activity timeline option once user will clicks on it logs details need to be shown as per wfx standard.
• Above screen will be used to define OCR logic with respect to customer and category with shipment threshold.
• It will also have option to include buyer shipment tolerance while considering sales order quantity for threshold validation if needed.
• User will be able to make a rule as Active or In-Active using status option.
• User will be able to edit and delete the rule, if needed.
• Change of rule will be applicable only for order falling in the criteria post the change.
• Change Log will be available to record changes made in this grid.
Prototype - OCR Rules - WFX

## Order Closure Workplace
There will be a new menu option as “Order Closure Workplace” under Sales >>Purchase Order from Buyers”.
• Data need shown OC wise in below screen.
• This page should include angular features like increasing column width rearranging columns, Pin sorting etc.
Grid Column Summary: -

[TABLE 1: Table 1 · 23 rows · columns: Status (text), OCR state (Pending, In-progress, Closed). – need to define how status will change. (text) · identifiers: Status]
| Status | OCR state (Pending, In-progress, Closed). – need to define how status will change. |
| Location | State of Factory/ office (e.g., Bengaluru, India). |
| Company Division | Internal business unit (e.g., MNB). |
| Style | WFX style Name |
| OC No | The OC No |
| Season | Season of the style |
| Merchant | Nam eo fthe merchant from Style Techpack (e.g., Rajesh, Sanjeev). |
| Buyer | Customer entity (e.g., Walmart, Target, H&M, Zara, Uniqlo). |
| Order Quantity | Total Sales Order Units |
| Shipment Qty | Total units shipped. |
| Return Qty | ASN Return Qty |
| Net Shipment Qty | Total Units Shipped – Return Qty |
| % of Net Shipment Qty | % of the total net shipped qty out of total order qty |
| Open OCs | Count of open orders. Since this screen will primarily designed for to run om Summary oc so sales order count will be one only. However, in future if customer requirement will be run OCR on style level then this count will have values based on total number of summary OCs in open state for a particular season |
| Open Indents | Count of Active Indents including OC liked Adhoc Indents |
| Transit PO | In Transit Pos for which full receiving is not done. |
| Production Unit | Manufacturing units where sales order has been produced (e.g., Unit 1, Unit 2, Unit 5). The columns after the production unit will be split as per unit selection will be based on sewing process |
| In-Transit Stock | In transit Material GDNs –only transfer GDIs data need to be shown. |
| Open Production Order | Count of active production orders. |
| Open Production Jobwork | Count of active internal or external production jobwork orders. |
| Last Shipment Date | Date of the most recent shipment. |
| OCR Initiated Date | Date the closure request was started. |
| Last FG Output Date | Last recorded finished goods production date. |
| Audit Completed On | Date the final audit was finalized. |

#### List Controls
Initiate OCR : This will user level configuration field which will be visible only once configured for respective user. User will be able to trigger OCR process selecting a OCR line and click on Initiate OCR Process tool.
Close Audit: This will user level configuration field which will be visible only once configured for respective user. User will be able to close OCR process by click on this tool. User will be able to Accept and Reject OCR request with comments. These comments will be visible on Line level Action history.
Log: There should be an Audit log covering date of initiation and Auditor comments with approval and rejection.
Task Closure: - Each department will have an option to close the task. However, if his responsible task (Like Open Indents, In Transit PO) are not zero then system will not allow to close the task. User can also select multiple lines to close the task.
Reason for delay: - If after 3 days of OCR initiation, if any task is not closed then there will be a reason for deploy which team has to mention. It will a dropdown and required a master in Sales Codes Reason for Delay for OCR.
On clicking Order Closure, a pop-up should appear with a text area where the user must enter remarks. The pop-up should also provide two buttons: Approve and Reject.
• When the user clicks Approve, the OCR will be closed, and its status should be updated to Closed.
• When the user clicks Reject, a new OCR should be initiated, and its status should be set to In Progress.
Prototype - Order Closure Workspace - WEX

## OCR work flow
There will be a OCR responsibility matrix to define OCR responsibilities work flow as below:
Navigation:- Admin Configurator Configuration Rules OCR Workflow
Fields:-
• Division:- When user will click on add it will show the Logged In Division.
• Buyer:- It will show dropdown of all the buyers.
• Department:- It will show below options in dropdown:- Merchandising, Sourcing, Production, Inventory.
• Factory:- It will show the factory of the logged in division
• Category: - It will show the category of production (like Apparel, Textiles / Fabric, Trims, Etc)
• Product Group: - It will show the product group of the category selected in previous column. It will be multi select and will also have “All” option.
• Sub Categories: - It will show the sub categories of the category and product group selected. It will be multi select and will also have “All” option.
• Responsible User: - It will show the users. Will be multi select.
Now, based on the department, those users will have visibility in OCR Workplace: -
• Merchant & Auditor: - All Columns, Initiate OCR
• Auditor: - All Columns, Close Order, OCR Summary
• Sourcing: - Status, Location, Company Division, Style, OC No, Season, Merchant, Buyer, Order Quantity, Shipment Qty, Return Qty, Net Shipment Qty, % of Net Shipment Qty, Open Indents, Transit PO, Open Production Job work (Only for their permission categories), OCR Initiated Date
• Inventory: - Status, Location, Company Division, Style, OC No, Season, Merchant, Buyer, Order Quantity, Shipment Qty, Return Qty, Net Shipment Qty, % of Net Shipment Qty, Production Unit, In-Transit Stock, OCR Initiated Date
• Production: - Status, Location, Company Division, Style, OC No, Season, Merchant, Buyer, Order Quantity, Shipment Qty, Return Qty, Net Shipment Qty, % of Net Shipment Qty, Production Unit, Open Production Order, Open Production Job work, Last Shipment Date, OCR Initiated Date, Last FG Output Date,
When user clicks on Set Matrix of “Escalation Matrix”, then below screen will open where we can set the escalation matrix for that user: -
It days threshold will be default greater than. Which means if any task is open for more than 2 days then it will go for escalation.
Min Value for days would be 1 and max value would be 99
This escalation will go to email and also in App.
Subject of all these emails: - OCR Initiation for OC No: - “”
Prototype -
This grid will provide option to define name of the person who is responsible for action against respective categories like action:
• Apparel for Sales Order closure
• Fabric & Trims for Indent closures.
Auto Email notification is also required to the email’s ids for these responsible users when an OCR is initiated.
Dear [UserName],
For OC: - [OC No (PO Ref)], OCR is initiate. Below are the open indents and Open Pos assigned to you. Please close them.
Open Indents
Open Pos
Thank You,
Team WFX

##### Controls:
There will be single person responsible for one action. System will restrict duplicate workflow.
While mapping user is able to select single category and multiple product group and sub category for a single user.
Based on this grid, OCR workflow will be triggered.
Values changed in this grid will impact on upcoming orders only.
There will be checkbox as Auditor against apparel category which will be used to define role of the Auditor.

#### Responsibility workflow

##### Merchant
Once shipment against OC reach to 90%, system will list that OC in above OCR due list. Same time system will show OCR request on “Actions Pending” widget of respective merchant who has marked as merchant in Techpack.
Name of the merchant:
This will be visible to the user selected as “Production Merchant” in respective style techpack. An auto Email will also go this user as per the email defined in the user master.
Action:
On the basis of alert, production merchant will review and close all open OC falling in OCR scope.

##### Sourcing Team
Sourcing team will ensure that all open indents and In Transit POs are closed. Auto Email notification will route to the respective users.
Email format:-
Dear [UserName],
For OC: - [OC No (PO Ref)], OCR is initiate. Below are the open indents and Open Pos assigned to you. Please close them.
Open Indents
Open Pos
Thank You,
Team WFX

##### Inventory team
Inventory team will ensure that all in-transit transaction are closed. Auto Email notification will route to the respective users.
Email format:-
Dear [UserName],
For OC: - [OC No (PO Ref)], OCR is initiate. Below are the In Transit Transaction pending with you. Please close them.
In Transit Stock:-
Thank You,
Team WFX

##### Factory team
Once all above transactions are closed then request will move to factory team. Auto Email notification will route to the respective users. Factory team will have an option to send it to auditor.

##### Auditor
This role will be defined as auditor against apparel category. There can be only one auditor for a customer and department.
Once all above actions are closed. OCR request will become visible in Auditor.
Upon closure of respective transactions, respective flag from Pending task widget will be removed.
Email format: -
Dear [UserName],
For OC: - [OC No (PO Ref)], OCR is initiated and all departments have closed the open items. Kindly review and close.
Thank You,
Team WFX

#### Controls & Validations
• If Summary Ocs are not closed then those will be highlighted in RED color.
• All Apparel type FPO & FPPOs should be closed.
• In case of Material Jobwork, FPO & FPPOs can be open which will not be considered here.
• Once Style OC falls in condition of OCR i.e. 90% of shipment. Shipment will send a notification to merchant for OCR Pending
• Once Merchant trigger the OC for OCR, a notification will be sent to Sourcing then inventory then production
• OCR Month will considered based on OCR completion date if it falls on and before 25th of the months else it will be marked for next month.

## OCR Summary
There will be a link on respective OCR line in OCR Closure Workspace screen (The screen in section 2) to show OCR Sumamry which multiple tabs
The column name will be “OCR Summary”
OCR Statistic
OCR FG Stock
OCR Stock Use

### OCR statistics
There will be a tab under OCR Closure Workspace which will be list present status of materials related to respective style OC. -
This screen will show style, OC level material information with present stock status like:
In-QC
Rejected
In-Transit
Total Stock
This screen will also have option to transfer materials using “Transfer” link if needed.

### OCR FG Stock
This screen will show all FGs with quality status. system should also facilitate quality categorization of rejected PCS like, rejected, B Grade etc. –
This screen will also have option to Trigger QC inspection Request and FG transfer request.
Max aging will be calculated from First GRN of that Stock.
If the QC status is still Pending or In Progress, and the user clicks the Transfer link, the system should display an appropriate alert message as “QC is not completed, so you cannot Transfer the Stock”
Unit :- Unit is the factory, it will show the factories where the Store is linked. If one store is linked with multiple factories then this will come comma separate. By default it will show 3 units then … (For Ex,;- Unit 1, Unit 2, Unit 3,…..)
User can select multiple lines from here and can click on the actions on header (QC/ Transfer).
When user will click on QC then system will create a auto QC Request for that and it will get route to QC Request list.
When user click on Transfer link then system will open below pop up where user will define the To Site.
On clicking on Confirm Transfer, the system will auto Create GDI, GDN and GRN to To Site for Non Rolls Stock.
For Roll stock the user have to create picklist, GDN and then GRN will get created automatically to To Warehouse.
If multiple from warehouse are there then GDI will be create on Warehouse level. For Ex:- If two from Warehouse are there then Two GDI, GDN and GRN will get created.

### Stock Reuse
Any leftover material allocation to other Style OC post or during OCR will be listed here.
The Stock Qty will show the qty that is currently allocated to “To Style”
Validations:
• OCR will be user base configurable
• Return Qty. should also consider for threshold calculation.
• Order Quantity: 1,000 pcs
• Shipment Threshold: 90%
• Return Quantity: 50 pcs
• Net Shipped Quantity: 850 pcs (900 shipped − 50 returned)
Calculation:
• Required for OCR = 900 pcs
• Net Shipment = 850 pcs
• Result: OCR Not Eligible because return quantity is deducted from the shipped quantity while calculating the threshold.
• if shipment quantity changes after OCR has already started then it will show in – progress.
• Merchant will not open a completed task.
• After OCR closure auditor is not able to re-open an OCR.
• After initiation user is not able to cancel OCR.

• Clarify how the completion of the sourcing activity will be confirmed.
• As discussed, the sourcing workflow should have a completion/confirmation mechanism, such as a checkbox or confirmation action.
• Once confirmed, the sourcing task will be completed and the next activity can proceed, including inventory/fabric-related activities.
